steps.what: Show the stored test method for this fuel cell project.
Conduct testing projects using stations and electrochemical diagnostics.

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} shows the test method already written for this project. The fuel cell engineer conducts the testing on the station, with the instruments or the electrochemical diagnostics the method names. Station runtime is not counted as the engineer's labour. A method with no station id leaves the test with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: A test was started on the wrong station because the method named only the project.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored method can be opened. The test still has to be conducted.
tasks.still_hard: A diagnostic the method does not name still has to be chosen on the station.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer conducts the test. The method is the note already written.
tasks.altitude: The test stays on the station. The stored method is visible, and station runtime is not treated as saved labour.

reach.task: Confirm the instrument named in the method is the one on the station.
reach.learn: A method title is not the test.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored test method is a lookup. It does not run a station or an electrochemical diagnostic.
Time the station or the instrument already spends running is not the engineer's labour.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The method id and the station id, both already stored. Diagnostic names are not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the method on the operations record before asking for a second copy.
unknowns: Whether cyclic voltammetry and impedance spectroscopy share one method record.
research_questions: Who attaches a station id to a test method?

already_counted.description: The station test stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop methods whose station record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still conducts the test on the station with the instruments or diagnostics the method names. Only opening a method that was already written is removed. Station runtime is not counted, and a method with no station id saves none of the test.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Analyze related rows for the named statistical measure.
Interpret that statistical result for this fuel cell test.

tasks.design: The {DATA_PLATFORM} totals the named statistical measure only when every selected row already holds it. The existing statistics program's runtime is not counted. The fuel cell engineer interprets the result and accepts the analysis. The accepted analysis is then filed. A row with no measure is left out, and the screen does not invent one.
tasks.previous_blocker: A mean was quoted from a program screen that still included rows from another test.
tasks.enabler_now: Rows that already hold the named measure can be counted. The interpretation still belongs to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A pattern the total does not show still has to be read by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer interprets the test. The total is arithmetic on stored rows.

ambition.what: Each stored test row that already has the named measure is included in that week's count and mean.

tasks.altitude: Interpretation stays with the engineer. The total is filed only after that analysis is accepted.

reach.task: Read an analysis the fuel cell engineer has already accepted.
reach.learn: A mean is not the finding.

evidence.claim: A count or a mean of a measure already stored on every row is arithmetic. It is not the interpretation of the test.
The runtime of a statistics program that already runs is not labour this task removes.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The measure name and a value for that measure on every selected row. A row missing the measure is left out. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Total the measure from the stored rows. Do not retype a number off a program screen.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the fuel cell engineer.
unknowns: Whether the named measure is the same field on every test type.
research_questions: Who names the measure before a test's rows are totaled?

already_counted.description: Interpreting the test and accepting the analysis stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop totals whose test rows have been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: test id, measure name, and the conclusion sentence the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still interprets the test and still accepts the analysis. Only totaling a measure that is already on every selected row, and filing the accepted analysis, is removed. Statistics-program runtime is not counted. A missing measure saves none of the interpretation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored failure note for this service.
Conduct failure analyses from that note and the part.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the failure note already written for this service. An equipment id alone is not the note, and a missing note stops the screen. The fuel cell engineer conducts the failure analysis from that note and the part. Only the analysis the engineer accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A failure was closed from a part number, and the note of what failed was still empty.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored failure note can be opened. The analysis still has to be conducted on the part.
tasks.still_hard: A cause the note does not describe still has to be found by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer conducts the analysis. The note is the record already written, not the cause.
tasks.altitude: The failure analysis stays with the engineer. Filing happens only after that analysis is accepted.

reach.task: Write the failure note before asking for an analysis.
reach.learn: A part number is not the failure.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored failure note is a lookup. An equipment id without that note does not supply the analysis.
Filing an analysis before the engineer accepts that version would store a cause nobody found.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The service id and the failure note already written. An equipment id without the note stops the step. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the failure note in the document store. Do not start from the equipment id alone.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the fuel cell engineer.
unknowns: Whether post-service notes and in-test failures share one note field.
research_questions: Who must write the failure note before an analysis starts?

already_counted.description: The failure analysis stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop notes whose service record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: service id and the cause sentence the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still conducts the failure analysis from the note and the part. Only opening a failure note that was already written, and filing the analysis already accepted, is removed. An equipment id with no note saves none of the analysis.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Copy property, unit, and measured value onto each open line.
Define specifications for these fuel cell materials.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store copies a property, a unit, and a measured value onto a specification line only when all three are already stored. The fuel cell engineer defines the limit and accepts the specifications. The copied line is not the limit. The accepted specifications are filed, and a missing measured value stops that line.
tasks.previous_blocker: A limit was typed into a specification that had no measured value behind it.
tasks.enabler_now: A complete lab row can be copied onto the line. The limit still has to be defined by the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A limit for a property the lab has not measured still has to be set by the engineer, or left open.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer defines the limit. The copied row is the measurement already stored.
tasks.altitude: The limit stays with the engineer. The specification is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Record the property, the unit, and the measured value.
reach.learn: A copied measurement is not the limit.

evidence.claim: Copying a stored property, unit, and measured value is a field copy. It does not define the limit.
Filing specifications before the engineer accepts that version would store a limit nobody set.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: Property, unit, and measured value, all three already stored on the lab row. The limit is not copied. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Copy the lab row into the specification line. Do not retype the measured value.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the fuel cell engineer.
unknowns: Whether one material has one specification or a specification per property.
research_questions: Who is allowed to change a measured value after it is on the lab row?

already_counted.description: Defining the limit and accepting the specifications stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop copied lines whose lab row has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: material id, property, and the limit the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still defines the limit and still accepts the specifications. Only copying a property, unit, and measured value that are already stored, and filing the accepted specifications, is removed. A missing measured value saves none of that judgement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The fuel cell engineer still runs the test, still interprets the data, still finds the failure, and still sets the material limit. A stored row can be totaled. It does not make the call.
reach: Test technicians run a station, and this job learns the station clock is not the engineer's test.
Quality staff read an accepted specification, and this job learns a copied measurement is not the limit.
skills_to_grow: Run the test on the station the method names.
Interpret a statistical result instead of treating the total as the finding.
Set a material limit only after the measured value is on the line.
role.ambitious_version: Testing, interpretation, failure analysis, and material limits stay with the engineer. Stored rows and measured values only show what was already recorded.
